Today's international headlines:
- Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent: Ukraine's leader says he will support such a truce if Moscow does, after initially expressing surprise at Donald Trump's announcement.
- Trump faces growing backlash over plans to import diesel from Russia: Both Republican and Democratic lawmakers have criticised the deal, which was announced weeks before the US midterm elections.
- One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days: The Saudi capital has been hit by multiple attacks from the Iran-backed Yemeni group over the weekend.
- Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, BBC finds.
- Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk: Police received credible information about possible attacks against Donald Tusk and his defence minister.
- Dozens of gold prospectors killed in strikes on Egypt-Sudan border, rights group says: Neither Egypt nor Sudan has commented on the alleged strikes on an artisanal mining camp on Saturday.
- Watch: Endangered orangutans released back into the wild after Borneo fires: The critically endangered apes were rescued from intense wildfires that destroyed their habitat in August and September.
- Iconic Australian band Powderfinger announce first tour in 17 years: The band, who announced their reunion last week, say they are "absolutely ecstatic" to be playing together again.
- Poland stabbings driven by online glorification of violence, Tusk says: The PM was speaking after violent attacks at Polish schools this week left one dead and others injured.
- Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal: Nepal is still trying to recover from catastrophic floods that hit less than two months ago, leaving thousands dead and missing.
- Children among 139 dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti, UN says: The boat was travelling from Djibouti to Yemen with 305 people on board, when it capsized near the port town of Obock on Thursday night.
- Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant: It is the third time this week that Ukraine has targeted Russian tech giant Yandex, forcing the company to suspend its operations.
